name: MN-05
label: Safe D

key_factors: Omar's incumbency and large fundraising edge
Markets price Democratic win near certain
model.rationale: Minneapolis-based MN-05 carries a +32 Democratic partisan lean, and incumbent Ilhan Omar has raised $5.8 million to John Nagel's $747 thousand, leaving him with under $50 thousand on hand. Prediction markets price a Democratic win at roughly 95%, consistent with a Safe D rating.
model.watch: A major national Republican wave or an unexpected Omar scandal could narrow the margin, though flipping the seat remains highly unlikely.
notes: No expert rater lists this race; treated as safe for the party holding the seat.
No usable general-election polls; forecast rests on fundamentals and expert ratings.

overview:
This heavily Democratic Minneapolis-area seat has a +32 partisan lean, making it one of the safest Democratic districts in the country. Incumbent Ilhan Omar is running for reelection after easily securing renomination.

Omar holds an overwhelming financial advantage, having raised $5.8 million to Republican John Nagel's $747 thousand, and she retains $1.3 million on hand while Nagel has under $50 thousand. No outside spending targets the race and no public general-election polling exists, but prediction markets put Democratic odds near 95%. The fundamentals point to a comfortable Omar win in the mid-twenties to low-thirties margin range.
